CaptureCommit.title: CaptureCommit

mission whose sources disagree shows it (`laser_colour_store`).
LaserColoursView.title: LaserColoursView

get.description: Every tenant, for a system admin's switcher; 404 for anyone else.
The tenants the caller belongs to (a partner's is their org's).
The caller's personal API tokens, newest first: never their secrets.

post.description:
A token that acts as the caller, for a script or an agent: ``read``
unless they ask for ``edit``. Its secret is in this response only.

get.description:
The tenant's current automatic lengths, by mission and capture
number; ``species`` keeps one, by scientific name. Unvalidated.

The current prediction's mask, as its PNG bytes (2026-10-22). A fix's
head and tail snap to it in the browser, as the app's do, and a page can
read an image's pixels only from its own origin: the web passes these
on. Read through the store's internal endpoint.
Label Studio project ids with live labels of ``kind``.

get.description:
The tenant's members by name and email (0065), with their review
levels: for its admins, who set those levels.

put.description: An admin sets a member's level in one kind; it is recorded as theirs.

get.description: One mission's current automatic lengths, by capture number.

delete.description:
Clear dive ``number``'s standing calibration refusal, so it is
fitted again (idempotent): for a change its labels don't show.
Unlink dive ``number`` from any borrowed calibration (idempotent).

put.description:
Dive ``number`` borrows dive ``source_number``'s laser calibration.

400 on a self-link; 404 if either dive is missing from the tenant.

delete.description:
Unlink dive ``number`` from any calibration target (idempotent): it
leaves the checkerboard cohort. A standing refusal is left as it is.

put.description:
Dive ``number`` was shot against calibration target
``target_number``: it enters the checkerboard cohort, and a standing
calibration refusal expires.

404 if the dive is missing from the tenant or no target has that
number.

get.description: Every capture of the mission, measured or not, in the order taken.

delete.description:
Withdraw a redraw of dive ``number``'s ``kind`` frames (idempotent:
0 when none was asked for).

put.description:
Redraw dive ``number``'s ``kind`` frames: the dive re-enters that
kind's preprocessing, and the JPEGs are redrawn where they are.
Incomplete labels only unless ``only_incomplete=false``.

State the mission's camera port as an operator (``unknown``
withdraws it). 409 where the owner's rules already say otherwise.

get.description:
Newest first, a page at a time: by number (``page``, from 1, of
``limit`` each) or after a cursor (``before``, the last page's
``next``), not both. ``total`` is how many there are in all.

The species the tenant's measured fish are, most first, with how
many of each: what the Fish page offers to filter by. Only the
tenant's own (the owner, 2026-10-23).

Where the tenant's wild fish were measured, by broad region, for
its Today map (`tenant_regions_store`). Fish models are left off.
The tenant's numbers, for its Today page (`summary_store`).

post.description:
A system admin, deliberately, becomes the admin of a tenant they are
not in, for `UNLOCK_MINUTES`; recorded. 404 for anyone else, and for a
tenant they are already a member of.
